   NHPs, especially macaques and marmosets, have brain structures and neural circuits that are remarkably similar to those of humans.    The scientific community is moving toward the adoption of the 3Rs: Replacement (with non-animal methods), Reduction (in the number of animals used), and Refinement (to minimize suffering). There is a strong push to use NHPs only when absolutely necessary and to continually seek and implement alternatives.

**Conclusion:**
NHPs remain an important model in brain research due to their close evolutionary relationship to humans and the complexity of their nervous system.
